---
# pagetitle names the browser tab; the page draws its own masthead below.
pagetitle: "The Life of a Bill"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    # No ¶ anchor icons on headings — these are app chrome, not sections
    anchor-sections: false
---

<!--
INSTRUCTOR/TA NOTE — editing this page:
Everything students read lives in the CONTENT block at the top of the
<script> section at the bottom of this file. To update dates, stage
text, or role tips, edit that block only — no need to touch the HTML
or CSS. This page began life as a standalone HTML file; it now renders
inside the site (navbar, footer), with all of its styling namespaced
under #loab so it can't fight the site theme.
-->

```{=html}
<style>
  #loab{
    --navy:#17345a; --navy-deep:#001B3D; --gold:#d4a821; --gold-bright:#DAA900;
    --paper:#F7F5F0; --sheet:#FFFFFF; --tint:#EEF2F8; --ink:#1E2735; --muted:#67707E;
    --line:#D9D4C8; --gold-wash:#F6EDD2;
    /* Role colors: Senate-chamber red (the CA Senate's House-of-Lords red), lobbyist green, journalist purple */
    --sen:#9D2235; --lob:#1E6B4E; --jou:#5F3A8E;
    /* Match the site's voice: EB Garamond display, Atkinson body, the
       site's navy and gold. (The SVG map keeps its own self-contained
       palette.) */
    --serif:"EB Garamond", Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    --sans:"Atkinson Hyperlegible", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--sans); line-height:1.55;
    /* as a grid item of Quarto's page grid, allow shrinking below the
       rail's content width so the rail scrolls internally on phones */
    min-width:0;
  }
  #loab *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0}
  /* Quarto's page CSS turns nested divs into grids, which gives our
     wrappers' children grid-item min-width:auto and lets the stage
     rail blow the page width open on phones. Our wrappers are plain
     blocks; :not([hidden]) keeps the map view's hidden attribute
     working (display:block !important would defeat it). */
  #loab{display:block !important}
  #loab > div:not([hidden]), #loab > header{display:block !important}
  #loab button{font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer}
  #loab .wrap{max-width:1060px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 22px}

  /* ---- masthead: the site's title treatment (Garamond over a double
     rule), compact, with the view toggle sharing the title row ---- */
  #loab .masthead{border-bottom:3px double rgba(23,52,90,.5); padding:4px 0 14px; margin-bottom:2px}
  #loab .mast-row{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:18px; flex-wrap:wrap}
  #loab h1{font-family:var(--serif); color:var(--navy); font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,38px); line-height:1.1; font-weight:500; margin:0; border:0; padding:0}
  #loab .dek{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink); max-width:78ch; margin-top:7px}
  #loab .dek em{font-style:normal; border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold); }
  #loab .views{display:inline-flex; border:1px solid var(--navy); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden}
  #loab .viewtab{background:#fff; color:var(--navy); border:0; padding:10px 18px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:600}
  #loab .viewtab + .viewtab{border-left:1px solid var(--navy)}
  #loab .viewtab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--navy); color:#fff}
  #loab .viewtab:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:-3px}

  /* ---- rail ---- */
  #loab .railzone{padding:16px 0 6px; position:relative}
  #loab .rail{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; position:relative; overflow-x:auto; padding:26px 4px 14px; scrollbar-width:thin}
  #loab .rail::before{content:""; position:absolute; left:34px; right:34px; top:47px; height:2px; background:var(--line)}
  #loab .stagebtn{flex:1 1 0; min-width:118px; background:none; border:0; text-align:center; position:relative; padding:0 6px}
  #loab .node{display:block; width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--sheet); border:2px solid var(--navy); color:var(--navy);
        font-family:var(--serif); font-size:19px; font-weight:700; line-height:40px; margin:0 auto 9px; position:relative; z-index:2;
        transition:background .18s,color .18s,border-color .18s, box-shadow .18s}
  #loab .stagebtn .name{display:block; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.25}
  #loab .stagebtn .mini{display:block; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px}
  #loab .stagebtn:hover .node{border-color:var(--gold); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--gold-wash)}
  #loab .stagebtn.active .node{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; border-color:var(--navy); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,40,86,.12)}
  #loab .stagebtn.active .name{color:var(--navy)}
  #loab .flag{color:var(--gold); font-size:12px; margin-left:3px}
  #loab .stagebtn:focus-visible{outline:none}
  #loab .stagebtn:focus-visible .node{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--gold)}
  /* the travelling bill */
  #loab #bill-token{position:absolute; top:8px; left:0; z-index:3; background:var(--gold-bright); color:var(--navy);
      font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; padding:3px 9px 2px; border-radius:4px 4px 4px 0; letter-spacing:.04em;
      box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.18); opacity:0; transform:translateX(0); pointer-events:none;
      transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1), opacity .3s}
  #loab #bill-token::after{content:""; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:-5px; border:3px solid transparent; border-top-color:var(--gold-bright); border-left-color:var(--gold-bright)}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ #loab #bill-token{transition:opacity .3s} }

  /* ---- stage sheet ---- */
  #loab .sheet{background:var(--sheet); border:1px solid var(--line); border-top:4px solid var(--navy); border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;
         padding:30px 34px 26px; margin:10px 0 34px; box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(30,39,53,.06)}
  #loab .sheet-head{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom:14px; margin-bottom:20px}
  #loab .sheet-head .stageno{font-family:var(--serif); color:var(--gold); font-size:30px; font-weight:700}
  #loab .sheet-head h2{font-family:var(--serif); color:var(--navy); font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,29px); font-weight:700; border:0; padding:0; margin:0}
  #loab .chip{background:var(--gold-wash); border:1px solid var(--gold); color:#6d5400; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; border-radius:999px; padding:3px 12px; margin-left:auto}
  #loab .cols{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.15fr .95fr; gap:34px}
  /* Quarto's MOBILE page-grid CSS assigns its named grid lines
     (body-content-start/end) to content descendants; inside our own
     grids those names don't exist, so items land in an implicit extra
     column and the page scrolls sideways. !important because Quarto's
     selectors carry their own ids and win a fair specificity fight. */
  #loab .cols > *, #loab .ghost-rail > *{grid-column:auto !important}
  #loab .explain h3, #loab .playbook h3{font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:7px}
  #loab .explain .block{padding-left:14px; margin-bottom:18px}
  #loab .explain .block.real{border-left:3px solid var(--line)}
  #loab .explain .block.sim{border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
  #loab .explain p{font-size:15px; color:var(--ink)}
  #loab .explain .block.sim h3{color:#8a6d00}
  /* playbook */
  #loab .playbook{background:var(--tint); border-radius:8px; padding:18px 20px 14px; align-self:start; border-top:4px solid var(--rc,var(--navy))}
  #loab .playbook[data-role="Senators"]{--rc:var(--sen)} #loab .playbook[data-role="Lobbyists"]{--rc:var(--lob)} #loab .playbook[data-role="Journalists"]{--rc:var(--jou)}

  #loab .playbook h3{margin-bottom:10px}
  #loab .tabs{display:flex; gap:6px; margin-bottom:14px; flex-wrap:wrap}
  #loab .tab{border:1.5px solid var(--rc,var(--navy)); background:#fff; color:var(--rc,var(--navy)); font-size:13px; font-weight:600; border-radius:999px; padding:5px 13px; transition:background .12s,color .12s}
  #loab .tab[data-role="Senators"]{--rc:var(--sen)} #loab .tab[data-role="Lobbyists"]{--rc:var(--lob)} #loab .tab[data-role="Journalists"]{--rc:var(--jou)}
  #loab .tab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--rc); color:#fff}
  #loab .tab:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:1px}
  #loab .tips{list-style:none}
  #loab .tips li{position:relative; padding:0 0 10px 20px; font-size:14.2px; color:var(--ink)}
  #loab .tips li::before{content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:7px; width:9px; height:9px; background:var(--rc,var(--gold)); border-radius:2px}
  /* small grey footnote at the bottom of a stage card (optional per
     stage via its note: field) */
  #loab .stage-note{margin-top:16px; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted)}

  /* pager */
  #loab .pager{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:22px; padding-top:16px; border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  #loab .pager button{background:none; border:1px solid var(--navy); color:var(--navy); border-radius:6px; padding:8px 15px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600}
  #loab .pager button:hover{background:var(--tint)}
  #loab .pager button:disabled{opacity:.35; cursor:default}

  /* ---- beyond the simulation ---- */
  #loab .beyond{margin:8px 0 46px}
  #loab .beyond h2{font-family:var(--serif); color:var(--muted); font-size:21px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:4px; border:0; padding:0}
  #loab .beyond .note{font-size:14px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:18px; max-width:70ch}
  #loab .beyond .note strong{color:var(--navy)}
  #loab .ghost-rail{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:14px}
  #loab .ghost{border:1px dashed #B9B2A2; border-radius:8px; padding:14px 16px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted)}
  #loab .ghost h4{font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:#7A7264; margin-bottom:4px}
  #loab .ghost p{font-size:12.8px; line-height:1.45}

  /* ---- map view ---- */
  #loab .mapzone{padding:30px 0 8px}
  #loab .mapwrap{overflow-x:auto; background:var(--sheet); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:18px 10px 6px; box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(30,39,53,.06)}
  #loab .mapwrap svg{display:block; min-width:900px; width:100%; height:auto}
  #loab .mapwrap svg text{font-family:var(--sans)}
  #loab .mapnode{cursor:pointer}
  #loab .mapnode rect{transition:filter .12s}
  #loab .mapnode:hover rect{filter:brightness(0.96)}
  #loab .mapnode:focus-visible rect{stroke:var(--gold); stroke-width:3}
  #loab .mapnote{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); margin:12px 2px 34px}

  @media (max-width:820px){
    #loab .cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    #loab .ghost-rail{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
    #loab .sheet{padding:22px 20px}
    #loab .stagebtn{min-width:104px}
  }
  @media (max-width:460px){ #loab .ghost-rail{grid-template-columns:1fr} }
</style>

<!-- column-page: Quarto's grid treats a plain top-level div as
     transparent and hoists its children out as separate grid items —
     which orphans every #loab-namespaced style. A column class makes
     the whole app one placed unit, contents untouched. -->
<div id="loab" class="column-page">

<header class="masthead">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="mast-row">
      <h1>The Life of a Bill</h1>
      <div class="views" role="tablist" aria-label="View">
        <button class="viewtab" data-view="stages" aria-selected="true">Stage by stage</button>
        <button class="viewtab" data-view="map" aria-selected="false">The map</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="dek">How a bill becomes a law in California, and how it works in <em>our simulation</em> — where your bill's journey ends at the Senate floor. Click any stage to see what's happening and what your role should be doing about it.</p>
  </div>
</header>

<div id="view-stages">
<div class="wrap railzone">
  <nav class="rail" id="rail" aria-label="Stages of a bill"></nav>
  <div id="bill-token" aria-hidden="true">Your bill</div>
</div>

<div class="wrap">
  <section class="sheet" id="sheet" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="sheet-head">
      <span class="stageno" id="s-no"></span>
      <h2 id="s-title"></h2>
      <span class="chip" id="s-chip" hidden></span>
    </div>
    <div class="cols">
      <div class="explain">
        <div class="block real"><h3>In real California</h3><p id="s-real"></p></div>
        <div class="block sim"><h3>In the simulation</h3><p id="s-sim"></p></div>
      </div>
      <aside class="playbook">
        <h3>Your playbook at this stage</h3>
        <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Role" id="tabs"></div>
        <ul class="tips" id="tips"></ul>
      </aside>
    </div>
    <p class="stage-note" id="s-note" hidden></p>
    <div class="pager">
      <button id="prevBtn">← Previous stage</button>
      <button id="nextBtn">Next stage →</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="beyond">
    <h2>Beyond the simulation</h2>
    <p class="note" id="beyond-note"></p>
    <div class="ghost-rail" id="ghosts"></div>
  </section>
</div>
</div>

<div id="view-map" hidden>
  <div class="wrap mapzone">
    <div class="mapwrap" id="map-holder"></div>
    <p class="mapnote">Click any box on the map to open that stage in detail. The gold-washed zones are the session's own business — things happening around that part of the map, not steps a bill takes. In real life the bill would continue on to the Assembly and the Governor — the map stops where the simulation stops.</p>
  </div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================================
   EDIT HERE — course content
   Every word on the page comes from this CONTENT object.
   - meta: the term and the dates. Update these each fall.
   - stages: one entry per stage. "real" and "sim" are the two explanation
     paragraphs; "roles" holds the tip lists for each role.
   - beyond: the grayed-out steps that only exist in real life.
   Write {billsDue}, {fiscal}, {approps}, {site} inside any text and the
   page will fill in the matching date from meta automatically.
   ========================================================================= */
const CONTENT = {
  meta: {
    billsDue: "Wednesday, September 30",
    fiscal:   "Friday, November 6",
    approps:  "Friday, November 20",
    site:     "ucmlegsim.com",
  },

  stages: [
    {
      title: "Ideas & drafting",
      short: "Before the bill exists",
      real: "Ideas for legislation come from everywhere — state agencies, citizens, the Governor, and lobbyists. A legislator takes the idea to the Legislative Counsel, whose office turns a sketch into formal bill language.",
      sim: "Every senator writes two bills, grounded in what your real-life counterpart and district actually care about. The smartest lobbyists are already working — bills are easiest to shape before they're written. Senators' bills are due {billsDue}.",
      roles: {
        Senators: [
          "Choose bills your district would love and the chamber could plausibly pass — you need both.",
          "Talk to lobbyists early. Their support is easier to win when they helped shape the bill.",
          "Line up coauthors before introduction — every name on the bill is a likely vote.",
        ],
        Lobbyists: [
          "Pitch bill ideas to sympathetic senators now, before anything is written.",
          "Know your group's real legislative program — your asks should look like it.",
          "Start mapping allies and opponents, senator by senator.",
        ],
        Journalists: [
          "Work your sources: who's writing what?",
          "Preview the session — tell readers which fights are coming.",
          "Introduce the players with profiles of the senators and groups to watch.",
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Introduction & first reading",
      short: "The bill goes public",
      real: "The author introduces the bill; it's numbered, read for the first time, and printed. Then it waits — a bill can't be heard in committee until the 31st day after introduction.",
      sim: "Bills are submitted and posted for everyone to read on {site}. There is no 31-day wait — the calendar is compressed, and the action starts almost immediately.",
      roles: {
        Senators: [
          "Publish a fact sheet for each of your bills — make the case in one page.",
          "Put out a press release. If you don't tell your bill's story, someone else will.",
          "Read everyone else's bills. You will be voting on all of them.",
        ],
        Lobbyists: [
          "Read every bill the day it posts, and sort them: support, oppose, watch.",
          "Open your bill-tracking list now — your final scorecard depends on it.",
          "Start drafting position letters on the bills that matter to your clients.",
        ],
        Journalists: [
          "Report the notable introductions — what would each bill actually do?",
          "Connect bills to their authors' districts and ambitions.",
          "Flag the sleepers: bills nobody is talking about yet.",
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Referral",
      short: "Bills routed to committees",
      real: "Each chamber's Rules Committee routes every bill to the policy committee that owns its subject — an agriculture bill goes to the Agriculture Committee.",
      sim: "Once the Senate has organized, the Appropriations/Rules Committee refers every bill to one of the three policy committees. Where your bill lands decides whose gavel controls its fate, and referral is a judgment call, which makes it politics.",
      note: "In our simulation, the Rules and Appropriations committees are combined into one body: the Appropriations/Rules Committee.",
      roles: {
        Senators: [
          "Watch where your bills are referred; the committee decides their fate.",
          "Make the case for a friendly referral before the assignments are filed, not after.",
          "Study who sits on your bill's committee — those are the votes that matter now.",
        ],
        Lobbyists: [
          "Map where each of your bills landed, and who sits on that committee.",
          "A bad referral is a client emergency — say so early, while it can still change.",
          "Introduce yourself to the chairs. You'll be testifying in front of them soon.",
        ],
        Journalists: [
          "Report the referrals — they signal what leadership wants to live and die.",
          "Explain what each of the three policy committees controls.",
          "Flag mismatches: a bill sent somewhere odd is a story.",
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Policy committee",
      short: "The first real test",
      chip: "Fiscal bills must clear committee by {fiscal}",
      real: "The committee holds a hearing: the author presents, and citizens, experts, and lobbyists testify. Then the committee acts — pass, pass as amended, amend and re-refer, or hold the bill, where it dies.",
      sim: "Your bill faces one of the three policy committees. Hearings run the same way: authors present, lobbyists testify, members question and then vote. Public comment is open to anyone not on the committee or defending the bill: step up as an invented “10-second” citizen or group with an interest in the bill, never as your simulation self. But the chair controls the agenda — a bill that never gets a hearing dies just as dead. Fiscal bills must clear their policy committee by {fiscal}.",
      roles: {
        Senators: [
          "Count the votes for and against your bill before the hearing, not during it.",
          "Prepare a tight author presentation, and arrange supportive witnesses.",
          "Use amendments strategically — to fix a bill, to win a vote, or to quietly gut one.",
          "Court the chair first — a bill that never makes the agenda dies without a vote.",
        ],
        Lobbyists: [
          "Deliver position letters before the vote, not after.",
          "Testify — and organize other lobbyists and witnesses to reinforce you.",
          "Brief friendly members with the questions you want asked.",
        ],
        Journalists: [
          "Cover the hearings — the drama of the session lives here.",
          "Report the roll calls your readers should care about — committee votes are news.",
          "Keep a casualty list: which bills died, and who killed them.",
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Appropriations",
      short: "The money gate",
      chip: "Out of Appropriations/Rules by {approps}",
      real: "Any bill that spends significant money is re-referred to the fiscal committee before it can reach the floor — a second gate, where many bills quietly stall.",
      sim: "Fiscal bills take the same extra step here. Everything must be out of Appropriations/Rules by {approps} — after that, what's left is what the floor will see.",
      roles: {
        Senators: [
          "Know whether your bill is fiscal — if it is, this gate applies to you.",
          "If cost is the objection, amend it down before someone kills it for you.",
          "Work the Appropriations members like your bill depends on it. It does.",
        ],
        Lobbyists: [
          "Make the fiscal case: what it costs, what it saves, and who benefits.",
          "This is where money bills die quietly — don't let yours go without a fight.",
          "Update your tracking; the field just narrowed.",
        ],
        Journalists: [
          "Follow the money: report what survived, and what it costs.",
          "The quiet deaths are stories too — who let a bill die, and why?",
          "So are the quiet rewrites: bills that lived, but with their funding gutted or transformed.",
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Second reading",
      short: "Last chance to amend",
      real: "Bills reported out of committee go onto the Second Reading file. Floor amendments can be proposed and adopted, and the bill is revised and reprinted.",
      sim: "The surviving bills join the floor agenda — “second reading” is just the official name for getting in line. It's the last, best chance to amend a bill, and floor time is limited: a bill that never gets taken up dies with the session.",
      roles: {
        Senators: [
          "Offer floor amendments now — after this, the bill is what it is.",
          "Whip your votes: know your yes, no, and persuadable columns by name.",
          "Trade support. Coauthoring and vote-trading are how floors work.",
          "Push leadership to take your bill up — a bill that's never heard dies when time runs out.",
        ],
        Lobbyists: [
          "Send your final position letters and make your last calls.",
          "Tell senators plainly: this vote goes on the scorecard.",
          "If an amendment helps your client, find a senator to carry it.",
        ],
        Journalists: [
          "Preview the floor fights — what passes, what's close, what's dead on arrival?",
          "Report the amendment maneuvers; they reveal the real politics.",
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Third reading & the vote",
      short: "The finish line",
      real: "The bill gets a final analysis, the floor debates, and the chamber votes — spending, urgency, and tax bills need a two-thirds supermajority. In real life, passing here only sends the bill on to the other chamber.",
      sim: "This is the finish line. The author presents the bill, the floor debates, and the roll is called. Pass and your bill has won — there is no Assembly and no Governor in the simulation.",
      roles: {
        Senators: [
          "Give floor speeches your constituents would cheer — they count toward your record.",
          "Weigh every vote: your voting record follows you onto the scorecards.",
          "Claim your wins — press releases, interviews, credit for coauthored bills.",
        ],
        Lobbyists: [
          "Log every roll call — the scorecard is your final product.",
          "Make the last-minute asks; floors have been flipped in the hallway.",
          "When your bills win, say so loudly: editorials, releases, credit.",
        ],
        Journalists: [
          "Report the votes and the drama — this is your front page.",
          "Editorialize: endorse, condemn, and explain what passage means.",
          "Tally the session: winners, losers, and what it all meant.",
        ],
      },
    },
  ],

  // Chamber business that is NOT a step in any bill's path, shown on the
  // map as gold-washed zones painted behind the part of the flow where
  // each happens, with these one-line captions. Keep them terse, and
  // keep them to point-in-time events — continuous work (letters, posts,
  // editorials) belongs in the role playbooks, not pinned to one spot.
  session: [
    { caption: "session opens — register, get roles, post profiles" },
    { caption: "the Senate organizes — leaders & committees chosen" },
    { caption: "chairs set each hearing's agenda" },
  ],

  beyondNote: "In real California, a bill that passes the Senate floor is only halfway home — the steps below still stand between it and the law books. <strong>In the simulation, none of this exists: passing third reading is winning.</strong>",
  beyond: [
    { t: "To the Assembly", d: "First reading, then the whole committee-and-floor gauntlet again in the other chamber." },
    { t: "Concurrence or conference", d: "If the Assembly amended the bill, the Senate must concur — or a conference committee splits the difference." },
    { t: "The Governor", d: "Sign it, ignore it (it becomes law anyway), or veto it — a veto takes two-thirds of each chamber to override." },
    { t: "Chaptered into law", d: "The Secretary of State chapters the bill; it takes effect January 1 unless it carries an urgency clause." },
  ],
};
/* ======================= end of editable content ======================= */

const fill = (t) => t.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => CONTENT.meta[k] ?? "");
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
let current = 0;
let role = "Senators";

/* build rail */
const rail = $("rail");
CONTENT.stages.forEach((st, i) => {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.className = "stagebtn" + (st.chip ? " deadline" : "");
  b.setAttribute("aria-label", `Stage ${i + 1}: ${st.title}`);
  b.innerHTML = `<span class="node">${i + 1}</span><span class="name">${st.title}${st.chip ? ' <span class="flag">⚑</span>' : ''}<span class="mini">${st.short}</span></span>`;
  b.addEventListener("click", () => show(i));
  rail.appendChild(b);
});

/* build role tabs */
const tabs = $("tabs");
["Senators", "Lobbyists", "Journalists"].forEach((r) => {
  const t = document.createElement("button");
  t.className = "tab"; t.setAttribute("role", "tab"); t.textContent = r; t.dataset.role = r;
  t.addEventListener("click", () => { role = r; renderTabs(); renderTips(); });
  tabs.appendChild(t);
});
function renderTabs() {
  [...tabs.children].forEach((t) => t.setAttribute("aria-selected", t.textContent === role ? "true" : "false"));
}
function renderTips() {
  const st = CONTENT.stages[current];
  document.querySelector("#loab .playbook").dataset.role = role;
  $("tips").innerHTML = (st.roles[role] || []).map((t) => `<li>${fill(t)}</li>`).join("");
}

function show(i) {
  current = Math.max(0, Math.min(CONTENT.stages.length - 1, i));
  const st = CONTENT.stages[current];
  $("s-no").textContent = current + 1;
  $("s-title").textContent = st.title;
  const chip = $("s-chip");
  if (st.chip) { chip.hidden = false; chip.textContent = fill(st.chip); } else chip.hidden = true;
  $("s-real").textContent = fill(st.real);
  $("s-sim").textContent = fill(st.sim);
  $("s-note").hidden = !st.note;
  if (st.note) $("s-note").textContent = fill(st.note);
  renderTabs(); renderTips();
  [...rail.children].forEach((b, j) => b.classList.toggle("active", j === current));
  const ab = rail.children[current];
  if (ab && rail.scrollWidth > rail.clientWidth) {
    rail.scrollTo({ left: ab.offsetLeft - rail.clientWidth / 2 + ab.clientWidth / 2,
      behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
  }
  $("prevBtn").disabled = current === 0;
  $("nextBtn").disabled = current === CONTENT.stages.length - 1;
  moveToken(current, true);
}

/* the travelling bill token */
function moveToken(i, visible) {
  const token = $("bill-token");
  const btn = rail.children[i];
  if (!btn) return;
  const railBox = rail.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  const node = btn.querySelector(".node").getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = node.left - railBox.left + node.width / 2 - token.offsetWidth / 2;
  token.style.transform = `translateX(${x}px)`;
  token.style.opacity = visible ? 1 : 0;
}

$("prevBtn").addEventListener("click", () => show(current - 1));
$("nextBtn").addEventListener("click", () => show(current + 1));
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (view !== "stages") return;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") show(current + 1);
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") show(current - 1);
});
window.addEventListener("resize", () => moveToken(current, view === "stages"));
rail.addEventListener("scroll", () => moveToken(current, view === "stages"));

/* ---- view switching ---- */
let view = "stages";
function setView(v) {
  view = v;
  document.getElementById("view-stages").hidden = v !== "stages";
  document.getElementById("view-map").hidden = v !== "map";
  document.querySelectorAll("#loab .viewtab").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", b.dataset.view === v ? "true" : "false"));
  if (v === "stages") requestAnimationFrame(() => moveToken(current, true));
}
document.querySelectorAll("#loab .viewtab").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => setView(b.dataset.view)));

/* ---- the map ---- */
function shortDate(d) { const p = d.split(", "); return p[p.length - 1]; }
function buildMap() {
  const M = CONTENT.meta;
  const navy = "#002856", gold = "#C99A00", brick = "#8C2B2B", muted = "#67707E";
  const node = (i, x, y, w, l1, l2, l2c) => `
    <g class="mapnode" data-stage="${i}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="${l1}">
      <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fff" stroke="${navy}" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="${x + w / 2}" y="${y + (l2 ? 25 : 33)}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14.5" font-weight="700" fill="${navy}">${l1}</text>
      ${l2 ? `<text x="${x + w / 2}" y="${y + 43}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="${l2c || muted}">${l2}</text>` : ""}
    </g>`;
  const dead = (x, y, w, l1, l2) => `
    <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="46" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="${brick}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
    <text x="${x + w / 2}" y="${y + 20}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="${brick}">${l1}</text>
    <text x="${x + w / 2}" y="${y + 36}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="${brick}">${l2 || "the bill dies"}</text>`;
  const arrow = (x1, y1, x2, y2) =>
    `<line x1="${x1}" y1="${y1}" x2="${x2}" y2="${y2}" stroke="${navy}" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>`;
  const darr = (x1, y1, x2, y2) =>
    `<line x1="${x1}" y1="${y1}" x2="${x2}" y2="${y2}" stroke="${brick}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#arrd)"/>`;
  // orthogonal elbow: down, across, down — rounded corners, arrowhead lands 4px above the target
  const elbow = (x1, y1, midY, x2, y2) => {
    const r = 8, dir = x2 > x1 ? 1 : -1;
    return `<path d="M${x1},${y1} L${x1},${midY - r} Q${x1},${midY} ${x1 + r * dir},${midY} L${x2 - r * dir},${midY} Q${x2},${midY} ${x2},${midY + r} L${x2},${y2}" fill="none" stroke="${navy}" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>`;
  };
  const band = (label, y) =>
    `<text x="14" y="${y}" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="${muted}" letter-spacing="2">${label}</text>`;
  const rule = (y) =>
    `<line x1="14" y1="${y}" x2="966" y2="${y}" stroke="#D8D2C2" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="0.1 9"/>`;

  // Session events painted INTO the flow: a gold wash behind the part of
  // the map where each happens — spatial like everything else, but
  // unmistakably not a node on any bill's path. Captions come from
  // CONTENT.session; an " — " splits a caption onto two lines.
  // capX lets a caption slide off the wash's center when a flow line
  // descends through it — text never sits on a line.
  const wash = (x, y, w, h, caption, capY, capX) => {
    const cx = capX || x + w / 2;
    const lines = String(caption).split(" — ");
    return `
    <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="12" fill="#C99A00" fill-opacity="0.13"/>
    ${lines.map((l, i) =>
      `<text x="${cx}" y="${capY + i * 13}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" font-weight="600" fill="#8a6d00">${l}</text>`
    ).join("")}`;
  };

  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 980 545" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Map of the simulation bill process">
    <defs>
      <marker id="arr" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="4.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L8,4.5 L0,9 z" fill="${navy}"/></marker>
      <marker id="arrd" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="4.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L8,4.5 L0,9 z" fill="${brick}"/></marker>
    </defs>
    ${wash(143, 30, 424, 104, CONTENT.session[0].caption, 111)}
    ${wash(577, 30, 202, 104, CONTENT.session[1].caption, 111)}
    ${wash(200, 168, 542, 94, CONTENT.session[2].caption, 253, 554)}
    ${rule(150)}
    ${rule(312)}

    ${band("GETTING STARTED", 34)}
    ${node(0, 155, 42, 170, "Ideas & drafting")}
    ${arrow(327, 70, 381, 70)}
    ${node(1, 385, 42, 170, "Introduction")}
    ${arrow(557, 70, 611, 70)}
    ${node(2, 615, 42, 150, "Referral")}
    ${elbow(757, 100, 140, 291, 176)}

    ${band("THE COMMITTEES", 172)}
    ${node(3, 200, 180, 182, "Policy committee", "⚑ clear by " + (M.fiscal.split(", ").pop()), "#8a6d00")}
    ${darr(198, 208, 176, 208)}
    ${dead(24, 185, 150, "Dies in committee", "never heard, or held")}
    ${arrow(384, 208, 448, 208)}
    <circle cx="456" cy="208" r="4" fill="${navy}"/>
    <text x="456" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="${muted}">does it spend money?</text>
    <text x="505" y="200" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="${navy}">yes</text>
    ${arrow(464, 208, 556, 208)}
    ${node(4, 560, 180, 182, "Appropriations", "⚑ out by " + (M.approps.split(", ").pop()), "#8a6d00")}
    ${darr(744, 208, 766, 208)}
    ${dead(770, 185, 150, "Dies in committee", "never heard, or held")}
    ${elbow(456, 214, 280, 275, 336)}
    <text x="365" y="272" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="${muted}">no — skips Appropriations</text>
    ${elbow(651, 238, 304, 307, 336)}

    ${band("THE FLOOR", 332)}
    ${node(5, 200, 340, 182, "Second reading", "joins the floor agenda")}
    ${darr(198, 368, 176, 368)}
    ${dead(24, 345, 150, "Never taken up", "time runs out")}
    ${arrow(384, 368, 556, 368)}
    ${node(6, 560, 340, 196, "Third reading", "author presents, debate, vote")}
    ${darr(758, 368, 780, 368)}
    ${dead(784, 345, 168, "Passage refused")}
    ${arrow(658, 398, 658, 452)}

    <g class="mapnode" data-stage="6" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Passed">
      <rect x="568" y="456" width="180" height="56" rx="10" fill="${gold}" stroke="${navy}" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="658" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="${navy}">Passed!</text>
      <text x="658" y="498" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-weight="600" fill="${navy}">law of the simulation</text>
    </g>
  </svg>`;
}
document.getElementById("map-holder").innerHTML = buildMap();
document.querySelectorAll("#loab .mapnode").forEach(n => {
  const go = () => { setView("stages"); show(parseInt(n.dataset.stage, 10)); window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" }); };
  n.addEventListener("click", go);
  n.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); go(); } });
});

/* beyond + meta */
$("beyond-note").innerHTML = CONTENT.beyondNote;
$("ghosts").innerHTML = CONTENT.beyond.map((g) => `<div class="ghost"><h4>${g.t}</h4><p>${g.d}</p></div>`).join("");

show(0);
</script>
```
